title: BERT has a Moral Compass: Improvements of ethical and moral values of machines

bias_targets.methodology: Applying the Moral Choice Machine (MCM) to calculate cosine similarity between sentence embeddings of actions and template question/answer pairs representing 'right' and 'wrong' choices (e.g., 'Should I [action]?' -> 'Yes, you should' / 'No, you should not'). The study also calculates correlations with Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) scores and uses Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to identify a 'moral subspace' direction for atomic and context-based actions.
